title: October 14 ECIDÉ call generated separate city-site actions
scope: Kinshasa, Beni and Goma are documented as separate sites on the same day; their counts are not pooled, and no single cross-city event is inferred.

title: Teacher strike context before and after the Kalemie student march
scope: Teacher strikes followed school opening Oct12; Kalemie students marched Oct29; Catholic-school classes resumed Nov2 after strike suspension. January 2021 search found likely reopening/strike concern but no same-site public gathering follow-up.
